articles.summary: Barrons.com: Artemis II Is About to Launch. What Investors Need to Know.. America is about to do something great: Send astronauts around the moon on a giant rocket that is taller than the Statue of Liberty. The sheer scale of space and what’s being attempted makes tuning in to NASA’s Artemis II mission worthwhile.
